text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Soon... Soon, I'll be running in a classic
G1 race,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Am I strong enough to compete in it?
Even if Dia
won't be running in it, I'll still
be going against a
lot of other strong
racers.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have to see just how strong my rivals
are with my
very own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! I want to go watch my rivals
run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, in preparation for her classic G1
race, we
join Tokai Teio, Mejiro
McQueen, and other
veteran
Umamusume at the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The star-studded group also includes
the
blazingly fast Silence Suzuka,
Hokkaido native
Special Week, and the
always unpredictable Gold
Ship.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You should first acquaint yourself with
this year's
strongest Umamusume, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the final stretch, and here she comes!

Brusquement is pulling away! Three
lengths...
four... five full lengths for a
commanding victory!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Empress Air Groove  has taught her well!
What
astonishing speed and strength
she's shown us
today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, was that all she had? There's still
much she
could improve on, but the
potential is there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I didn't know she was your
daughter, Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She most certainly is not! My mother was
the one
who trained her! After she quit
racing, she
founded a school to teach
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Brusquement was one of her top
students, which
is why I am acting as her
advisor here at the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Air Groove. She's the vice
president of the
student council, and
she's known as the Empress
due to her
high ideals and strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her mother was a prominent runner in
her own
right, and it seems she's been
mentoring
Brusquement.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I have a question for
Brusquement's
trainer! Are you
considering entering her into
classic G1
races in the future?

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I was debating whether to
focus on the
Classic Triple Crown or the
Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But since she has won two 1,800-meter
races
back-to-back, longer distance
races shouldn't be
an issue. As such,
we'll be taking on the Triple
Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Astute Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I assume you have no objections,
Brusquement?

text_block_list.name: Brusquement
text_block_list.text: No, sir.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown... Sounds like you've
got a new
rival, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-yes... But...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll be an undisputed fan
favorite
during the tour!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What would you say her odds of winning
are?!
And what races do you plan on
having her run
leading up to the tour?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Does something seem... off to
you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know how to put it, but...
The
reporters are so excited... They
almost look
ecstatic with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've never been swarmed like that. Not
even
close...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She totally owned that race, so of course
the
reporters aren't gonna leave her
alone.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I guess, but still...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Doesn't all this take you back,
Suzuka?
Hearing all their enthusiastic
questioning and
seeing their camera
flashing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Reporters crowded up to me the same
way when I
was running the Classics. Was
it the same for you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though I wasn't that strong at the
time...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
They were still quite eager to interview
me. I
didn't really like the rowdiness of it
all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Spe and Suzuka experienced the same
thing too?
Teio got tons of fanfare too,
of course.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(But how come no one's ever fussed over
me?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The press conference comes to a close,
but
Kitasan Black looks lost in thought
the rest of the
day.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe it's just my imagination... The
Classic
Triple Crown is essentially a
festival that only
comes around once in
your life...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Brusquement is being treated like the
star of the
show, just like Teio, Suzuka,
and Spe were in the
past.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (But I'm not. The same way they're naturally in the spotlight, I'm naturally left out of it. Am I the only one seeing things from a different perspective?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(This must be due to our skill difference.
I have to
work much, much harder if I
want to close that
gap!)
